operators.title: Scatter
operators.summary: Place roots across the bound rest surface at a chosen density. Stable root IDs keep downstream randomization repeatable.
operators.execution: CPU reference and supported CUDA configurations
operators.output: Root points and frames, ready for Grow or Guide Interpolate.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:subdivisionLevel
parameters.description: Smooth root placement to OpenSubdiv limit patches. Zero uses the polygon cage; levels 1–6 require suitable quad topology and run on CPU. Level 3 is a useful felt setting.

parameters.name: usdGen:density
parameters.description: Expected roots per unit of rest-surface area. Must be finite and >= 0; the per-face count is density * restArea * mask, rounded stochastically.

parameters.name: usdGen:flip
parameters.description: Reverse tangent and binormal directions in every root frame. This changes how downstream directional styling is oriented.

workflow: Bind a mesh as the description surface.
Set density and seed, then author Grow or Guide Interpolate as an upper sibling of Scatter so it runs afterward.
tips: Start with low density while tuning the silhouette; increase it for the final coat.
pitfalls: Density is per unit of rest surface area; scene scale changes the visible count.
Subdivision levels above zero need a suitable quad mesh and run on CPU.

operators.title: Grow
operators.summary: Turn each scattered root into a straight strand. Length, direction, lift, and azimuth establish the base coat before styling.
operators.execution: CPU reference and supported CUDA configurations
operators.output: Curves with a fixed number of CVs.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:segments
parameters.description: CVs per generated strand, in [2, 64]. This is the operator that fixes the CV topology of the chain.

parameters.name: usdGen:length
parameters.description: Base strand length in scene units. Must be finite and >= 0; the per-curve target is length * lengthRandom draw.

parameters.name: usdGen:lengthRandom
parameters.description: Per-curve multiplier range (lo, hi) applied to usdGen:length. A reversed pair is swapped; both components must be finite and >= 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:direction
parameters.description: Growth direction mode: "surfaceNormal" uses the root frame normal, "vector" uses usdGen:directionVector verbatim.

parameters.name: usdGen:directionVector
parameters.description: Explicit growth direction in description space, used when usdGen:direction is "vector". Normalised before use; every component must be finite.

parameters.name: usdGen:lift
parameters.description: Rotation of the growth direction around the root binormal, in degrees, in [-90, 90].

parameters.name: usdGen:azimuth
parameters.description: Rotation around the root normal after lift, in degrees in [-360, 360]. Zero preserves the existing face-local lean.

parameters.name: usdGen:azimuthRandom
parameters.description: Per-strand azimuth variation in [0, 1]: adds a stable uniform offset in [-180, 180) degrees multiplied by this value. One distributes the lean around the full circle, avoiding face-axis patterns in isotropic felt. Seeded by usdGen:seed and stable strand ID, independently of length. Zero preserves existing direction.

workflow: Place Grow after Scatter.
Set segment count and length, then adjust direction and lean.
tips: Use azimuthRandom to break up face-axis patterns on short fur.
pitfalls: Segments changes CV topology; add enough CVs for later bends without overbuilding.

operators.title: Guide Interpolate
operators.summary: Grow dense strands by blending nearby authored guides in the root frame. Region controls can keep separate parts from borrowing each other’s guides.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type
inputs: A sparse BasisCurves guide set via usdGen:guides
operators.output: Guide-shaped curves and guide index/weight planes.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:guides
parameters.description: The guide curves: one BasisCurves prim whose curves are the sparse guides. Each input root grows a strand of usdGen:cvCount CVs by blending the root-local shapes of its nearest guides.

parameters.name: usdGen:cvCount
parameters.description: CVs per generated strand, in [2, 64]. Guides are resampled to this count by arc length.

parameters.name: usdGen:maxGuides
parameters.description: Most guides blended into one strand, in [1, 8]. The heaviest three are published per strand as guideIndex/guideWeight.

parameters.name: usdGen:influenceRadius
parameters.description: Search radius around a strand root, in rest scene units; a guide root farther away does not contribute. A strand with no guide in reach follows the nearest guide of its region. Must be finite and > 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:influenceDecay
parameters.description: Falloff exponent: a guide at distance d weighs (1 - d / influenceRadius)^influenceDecay before normalisation. 0 weighs every guide in reach equally. Must be finite and >= 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:maxGuideAngle
parameters.description: Largest angle, in degrees, between a strand's root normal and a guide's root normal for the guide to contribute, in [0, 180]. Keeps guides on one side of a thin surface off the other.

parameters.name: usdGen:blendMethod
parameters.description: How guide shapes blend: "linearBlend" averages the guides' root-local CV offsets; "extrudeAndBlend" averages their segment directions and lengths and extrudes the strand from its root, which keeps the length when guides diverge.

parameters.name: usdGen:blendInSkinSpace
parameters.description: 1 turns each guide's shape by the rotation that takes the guide's root normal onto the strand's before blending, so strands follow a curved surface; 0 copies the shapes unrotated; values between rotate partially. In [0, 1].

parameters.name: usdGen:useUniqueGuide
parameters.description: Each strand copies its single heaviest guide instead of blending several.

parameters.name: usdGen:randomizeGuide
parameters.description: Per strand, per guide random reduction of the guide weights, in [0, 1]; breaks up the blend and, with useUniqueGuide, varies which guide a strand copies. Keyed by (usdGen:seed, curve id, guide).

parameters.name: usdGen:region
parameters.description: Region id per strand. A guide only shapes strands of its own region, and a guide's region is the value at its root (read from the strand rooted nearest it). Connect a UsdGenExpression to part the groom: a ptex("<map>") region map, or a voronoi over the guide roots such as geoSampler("guideCurves", "$index"). Values that differ by less than 1/1024 are the same region. Unconnected, every strand is in one region.

parameters.name: usdGen:regionCrossover
parameters.description: Weight scale for guides of another region, in [0, 1]. 0 keeps region borders hard (parting lines); larger values let neighbouring regions' guides soften the border.

workflow: In usdview, use Pomade to author sparse guides and Build the hair description, which commits guide BasisCurves under the groom. Point usdGen:guides at those curves, then use Pomade Save groom to save the groom layer.
Adjust search radius, guide count, and blend method.
Use region values for hard or soft part boundaries.
tips: extrudeAndBlend keeps strand length better when guides diverge.
pitfalls: This is a CPU reference operator.
A root with no guide inside the radius falls back to the closest guide in its region.
GuideInterpolate reads authored or baked C3 guide CurveSets. A live Clump operator is not a guide-curve target; bake or commit its result as BasisCurves before using it as guides.

operators.title: Reference Source
operators.summary: Bring a baked in-stage BasisCurves snapshot into the chain.
operators.execution: CPU reference and supported CUDA configurations
operators.output: Imported curves with their captured channels.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:reference
parameters.description: The in-stage BasisCurves prim whose baked geometry this source pulls into the operation stack (contract C3). Exactly one target is required.

workflow: Point usdGen:reference at one in-stage curve prim.
Style or deform the resulting curves downstream.
tips: Use a stable, published snapshot when a procedural groom needs a fixed starting point.
pitfalls: Exactly one reference target is required.

operators.title: Curve Source
operators.summary: Load authored BasisCurves into the groom. It can also expand a sparse surface cage into transient dense curves at cook time.
operators.execution: CPU reference and supported CUDA configurations
operators.output: Source curves or transient surface-cage output.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:curves
parameters.description: The authored BasisCurves prim this source reads (contract C3). Exactly one target is required; it is the only way curve data enters the engine.

parameters.name: usdGen:interpolationMode
parameters.description: Source expansion mode. "none" reads authored C3 curves normally; "surfaceCage" turns sparse C3 cage rails into transient dense output at cook time. The dense result is never authored back to the stage.

parameters.name: usdGen:densityMultiplier
parameters.description: Positive multiplier applied to each surface-cage owner's authored density when generating transient dense output.

parameters.name: usdGen:regionMap
parameters.description: The categorical UsdGenPtexMap used by surfaceCage interpolation. Channel values are ownerId + 1; zero rejects output roots.

parameters.name: usdGen:regionMapChannel
parameters.description: The categorical channel to sample from usdGen:regionMap for surfaceCage interpolation.

parameters.name: usdGen:expectMapGeneration
parameters.description: Required captured texture generation of usdGen:regionMap for surfaceCage interpolation. A mismatch is a cook error rather than a stale-map fallback.

parameters.name: usdGen:useRest
parameters.description: True reads the source as rest-space geometry and requires an authored rest snapshot; false accepts already-posed points.

parameters.name: usdGen:idSource
parameters.description: Where stable curve ids come from: "primvar" uses the authored curveId primvar, "index" synthesizes them from the source ordering.

parameters.name: usdGen:expectEpoch
parameters.description: Expected frozen-curve epoch string. Empty disables the check; otherwise a mismatch is reported through usdGen:staleAction.

parameters.name: usdGen:staleAction
parameters.description: What to do when the source epoch does not match usdGen:expectEpoch: "warn", "ignore", or "block" (a hard error).

parameters.name: usdGen:resampleTo
parameters.description: Resample every source curve to this CV count. 0 keeps the authored topology; any other value must be >= 2.

parameters.name: usdGen:rebind
parameters.description: When to re-derive root bindings and frames from the bound surface: "never", "onError", or "always".

workflow: Author curves with root bindings and stable IDs.
Target them with usdGen:curves; choose rest-space reading and rebind behavior.
Use surfaceCage mode only for a compatible cage and region map.
tips: Keep idSource=primvar for edits that must survive curve reordering.
pitfalls: useRest=true requires a rest snapshot.
surfaceCage uses a categorical Ptex map and generation guard.

operators.title: Clump
operators.summary: Pull neighboring strands toward clump centers, with a root-to-tip strength ramp and optional nested clump levels.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type
operators.output: Curves plus a typed quartet per level: clumpId_<n> (uniform membership), clumpCenter_<n> (uniform rest anchor), clumpCenterId_<n> (uniform stable center identity), and clumpWeight_<n> (vertex effective cohesion).

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:amount
parameters.description: Pull strength toward the clump centre strand, in [0, 1], scaled per CV by the profile ramp.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:profile:knots
parameters.description: (position, value) ramp knots with position in [0, 1] along the strand, multiplying usdGen:clump:amount: the default leaves roots free and pulls tips fully. Empty knots mean a flat 1.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:profile:interpolation
parameters.description: Interpolation of usdGen:clump:profile:knots.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:map
parameters.description: Clump membership. Connect a UsdGenExpression to cluster strands by a map: strands whose values are equal (within 1/1024) form one clump, centred on the member rooted nearest the group's centroid. A ptex("<map>") read of a UsdGenPtexMap region map makes the map's cells the clumps; a geoSampler voronoi makes the sampled points the clump seeds. Unconnected, clump centres are scattered at usdGen:clump:density.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:density
parameters.description: Clump centres per unit of rest-surface area when usdGen:clump:map is unconnected (and for every level after the first). Centres are picked among the strands with a minimum spacing, keyed by usdGen:seed. Must be finite and >= 0; at least one centre is always picked.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:size
parameters.description: Reach of a clump in rest scene units: a strand rooted farther than this from its centre is not clumped. Must be finite and > 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:level
parameters.description: Index of the first clump metadata level this operator publishes. -1 allocates the next free contiguous range in compiled order, reserving all preceding Clump levels (including disabled nodes) and imported C3 clump levels. Explicit indices must not overlap an occupied range.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:levels
parameters.description: Clumping levels, in [1, 4]. Every level after the first splits each clump of the previous level into smaller clumps of density / sizeReduction^(2L), reach size * sizeReduction^L and strength amount * tightnessReduction^L, centred on strands as the previous level left them.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:sizeReduction
parameters.description: Per-level scale of the clump size, in (0, 1].

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:tightnessReduction
parameters.description: Per-level scale of the pull strength, in [0, 1].

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:method
parameters.description: Pull target: "linearBlend" pulls each CV toward the centre strand's CV at the same parameter, so tips converge; "extrudeAndBlend" pulls toward the centre strand's shape moved to the strand's own root, so strands align without converging.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:stray:amount
parameters.description: Pull removed from a stray strand, in [0, 1], growing toward the tip as t^falloff.

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:stray:rate
parameters.description: Share of strands that stray, in [0, 1], picked by (usdGen:seed, curve id).

parameters.name: usdGen:clump:stray:falloff
parameters.description: Exponent of the stray profile along the strand; must be finite and >= 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:preserveLength
parameters.description: 1 restores every segment to its input length after the pull, root locked; 0 keeps the pulled lengths; values between blend. In [0, 1].

workflow: Start with a moderate amount and a profile that keeps roots apart.
Set center density and reach; add stray variation if the result is too even.
tips: Use a Ptex or expression map to define designed clump memberships.

Native clumps carry a stable center identity, rest anchor and root-to-tip effective cohesion downstream. Wind, Noise, Curl and Bend share procedural variation only to the extent of the surviving cohesion at each CV; weaker or stray CVs retain individual variation.
pitfalls: The reach is in rest scene units.
This is a CPU reference operator.
A clump ID alone records membership, not how strongly a strand follows the group. Preserve the native center and weight planes when baking or moving curves between stacks.

operators.title: Noise
operators.summary: Add coherent, multi-octave positional variation along strands.
operators.execution: CPU for clump-weighted coherence; CUDA/Vulkan only for admitted unclumped or legacy ID-only configurations

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:magnitude
parameters.description: Peak displacement of the frizz field in scene units, before the magnitude ramp and the mask envelope.

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:magnitude:knots
parameters.description: Root-to-tip ramp on the displacement magnitude as (position, value) pairs with position in [0, 1]. Empty is a flat ramp of 1.

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:magnitude:interpolation
parameters.description: Interpolation of usdGen:noise:magnitude:knots: "linear", "catmullRom", "bspline" or "constant".

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:frequency
parameters.description: Spatial frequency of the fBm field, in cycles per scene unit.

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:correlation
parameters.description: How strongly neighbouring strands share one noise draw, clamped to [0, 1]. 0 is fully independent per curve.

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:octaves
parameters.description: Number of fBm octaves, in [1, 6].

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:lacunarity
parameters.description: Frequency multiplier between successive fBm octaves; must be > 1.

parameters.name: usdGen:noise:gain
parameters.description: Amplitude multiplier between successive fBm octaves, in [0, 1].

parameters.name: usdGen:cumulative
parameters.description: True accumulates the displacement along the strand so the tip carries the sum; false displaces every CV independently.

parameters.name: usdGen:preserveLength
parameters.description: Arc-length restoration after displacement, in [0, 1]. Values at or above 0.999 restore every segment length exactly; lower values leave the strand stretched.

workflow: Place after the primary shape is established.
Tune magnitude, frequency, correlation and the root-to-tip ramp.
tips: Small magnitude with a tapered ramp adds detail without breaking the scalp line.

After native Clump, cohesive CVs blend the noise field with a field sampled at their clump rest anchor. Per-CV magnitude, frequency, correlation and detail remain authored controls; cohesion does not average these values.
pitfalls: Large magnitude can alter silhouette and strand length.
The cumulative mode changes how displacements accumulate.

Clump-aware Noise that uses effective cohesion runs on CPU. CUDA and Vulkan reject a reachable Noise fed imported clumpWeight_<n> planes; legacy ID-only or unclumped input may still qualify under each backend's other admission rules.

operators.title: Length
operators.summary: Set or scale strand lengths using a per-curve target and stable random variation. Short strands can be collapsed to zero length.
operators.execution: CPU reference and supported CUDA configurations
operators.output: Curves with repositioned CVs and stable IDs.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:length:mode
parameters.description: set treats length:value as a target in scene units; scale and cull multiply the input length. Culling uses thresholds and currently collapses strands to zero length.

parameters.name: usdGen:length:value
parameters.description: Target length in scene units ("set") or multiplier ("scale"). Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:length:random
parameters.description: Per-curve multiplier range (lo, hi) on the resolved length. A reversed pair is swapped; both components must be finite and >= 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:length:method
parameters.description: scale and cutExtend are accepted tokens. The current kernel applies the same radial scaling for both.

parameters.name: usdGen:rebuild
parameters.description: Declared CV parameterization choice. The current kernel leaves CV count and parameterization unchanged.

parameters.name: usdGen:minRemainingLength
parameters.description: Collapse a strand to zero length when its resolved target is below this scene-unit minimum. Zero disables this test.

parameters.name: usdGen:cullThreshold
parameters.description: Collapse a strand to zero length when its resolved target is below this scene-unit threshold. Zero disables this test.

workflow: Choose set for an absolute target or scale for a multiplier.
Set value and random range; use the thresholds to collapse short strands.
tips: Apply before late detail so Noise and Curl respond to final length.
pitfalls: The current kernel zero-lengthens strands below a threshold; it does not remove curves.
cutExtend and rebuild are declared controls but do not change the current radial scaling method.

operators.title: Width
operators.summary: Set strand widths with a root-to-tip ramp. Width can replace the input or multiply it.
operators.execution: CPU reference and supported CUDA configurations
operators.output: Curves with a width value for every CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:width
parameters.description: Base strand width in scene units before the ramp and the mask envelope. Must be >= 0.

parameters.name: usdGen:width:knots
parameters.description: Root-to-tip width ramp as (position, multiplier) pairs with position in [0, 1]. Empty is a flat ramp of 1.

parameters.name: usdGen:width:interpolation
parameters.description: Interpolation of usdGen:width:knots: "linear", "catmullRom", "bspline" or "constant".

parameters.name: usdGen:replace
parameters.description: True sets the width plane from this operator's profile; false multiplies the incoming widths by it.

workflow: Set a base width and taper ramp.
Use replace=false to scale widths from an earlier Width node.
tips: A narrow tip ramp avoids blunt looking fur.
pitfalls: Widths are in scene units; look at a render at intended camera distance.

operators.title: Width Blend
operators.summary: Blend the width plane of two matching curve streams with an ordered weight. This runtime operator has no generated USD schema prim.
operators.availability: Runtime only; no typed USD schema prim
operators.execution: CPU reference and supported CUDA configurations
inputs: Two curve streams identical except for width

parameters.name: usdGen:widthBlend:weight
parameters.description: Ordered blend weight in [0, 1]; zero uses the left width and one uses the right width.

workflow: Provide left and right matching curve inputs through the graph descriptor.
Set widthBlend:weight from 0 (left) to 1 (right).
tips: Useful when two width treatments share exact curve geometry.
pitfalls: This is a runtime-only operator; a standard typed UsdGenWidthBlend prim is not available.
Any difference outside the width plane is rejected.
The graph descriptor requires enabled=true and accepts only widthBlend:weight as a parameter; there is no seed or mask control.

operators.title: Direction
operators.summary: Reorient strands toward a vector, with controls for lift, tilt, spin, surface contour, and rigid or progressive bending.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:direction
parameters.description: Target combing direction in description space; a curve-set source can supply captured tangents instead.

parameters.name: usdGen:amount
parameters.description: Fraction of rotation toward the target direction.

parameters.name: usdGen:lift
parameters.description: Additional rotation around the root binormal, in degrees.

parameters.name: usdGen:tiltU
parameters.description: Rotate the target about the root tangent, in degrees.

parameters.name: usdGen:tiltV
parameters.description: Rotate the target about the root binormal, in degrees.

parameters.name: usdGen:tiltN
parameters.description: Rotate the target about the root normal, in degrees.

parameters.name: usdGen:aroundN
parameters.description: Additional rotation about the root normal after tiltN.

parameters.name: usdGen:followSkinContour
parameters.description: Blend the target toward its projection into the root tangent plane.

parameters.name: usdGen:direction:source
parameters.description: Optional curve set or operator whose tangents supply the target. Map targets are not supported.

parameters.name: usdGen:direction:knots
parameters.description: Root-to-tip ramp for the direction influence.

parameters.name: usdGen:direction:interpolation
parameters.description: Interpolation of the direction ramp.

parameters.name: usdGen:mode
parameters.description: rigid rotates CV offsets around the root; perSegment accumulates turns while preserving segment lengths.

workflow: Set direction and amount.
Adjust tilt and the direction ramp to control root-to-tip influence.
tips: Use gradual influence for a combed coat while retaining root attachment.
pitfalls: The direction:source map relationship is declared but this kernel refuses map-driven direction.

operators.title: Smooth
operators.summary: Average a curve along itself or against nearby curves to remove kinks and stray noise.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:strength
parameters.description: Blend factor toward the smoothed position.

parameters.name: usdGen:iterations
parameters.description: Number of smoothing passes.

parameters.name: usdGen:mode
parameters.description: alongCurve smooths each strand internally; neighbours blends same-index CVs of nearby strands.

parameters.name: usdGen:lockRoot
parameters.description: Keep root CVs fixed during smoothing.

parameters.name: usdGen:searchRadius
parameters.description: Maximum root distance for strands to count as neighbors.

parameters.name: usdGen:numNeighbors
parameters.description: Maximum nearby strands used for each neighbor-mode blend.

workflow: Set strength and iteration count.
Choose alongCurve or neighbor mode and decide whether roots stay locked.
tips: Use after guide interpolation or sculpt work to soften uneven shapes.
pitfalls: High strength or many iterations can flatten intended detail.

operators.title: Resample
operators.summary: Redistribute CVs along every strand to a chosen count.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type
operators.output: Curves with a new CV topology.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Blend each output CV toward the resampled position. CV count still changes at zero mask; zero retains the nearest input CV shape at the new count.

parameters.name: usdGen:cvCount
parameters.description: Number of CVs to produce on each strand.

parameters.name: usdGen:distribution
parameters.description: Spacing rule for resampled CVs.

parameters.name: usdGen:restoreSegmentLengths
parameters.description: Restore original segment lengths after placing the new CVs.

workflow: Choose cvCount and spacing distribution.
Enable segment-length restoration when the shape needs it.
tips: Place before CV-sensitive operators to give them predictable resolution.
pitfalls: Changing CV count invalidates CV-indexed sculpt deltas and other topology-dependent data.

operators.title: Scale
operators.summary: Scale strand shape along its length, with a ramp and per-curve random multiplier. It can scale widths too.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type
operators.output: Scaled curves and optionally scaled widths.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:scale
parameters.description: Base multiplier of every offset from the root.

parameters.name: usdGen:scale:knots
parameters.description: Root-to-tip multiplier ramp.

parameters.name: usdGen:scale:interpolation
parameters.description: Interpolation of the scale ramp.

parameters.name: usdGen:scaleRandom
parameters.description: Per-curve random multiplier range.

parameters.name: usdGen:widthToo
parameters.description: Apply the same local multiplier to strand widths.

workflow: Set scale and its root-to-tip ramp.

operators.title: Collide
operators.summary: Correct contact against mesh surfaces, with optional temporary shortening for deep penetration and clearance around open surfaces.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type
inputs: Bound surface and optional collider targets
operators.output: Collision-corrected curves with optional temporary shortening and surface clearance.

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:colliders
parameters.description: Optional Mesh or face GeomSubset targets added to the bound scalp. Valid Catmull-Clark, Loop and bilinear meshes use their evaluated subdivision limit. Meshes with subdivisionScheme=none use their polygon surface; otherwise-valid unsupported or rejected topology emits a path-and-scheme warning before polygon fallback. Consistently oriented watertight meshes eject interior CVs. Open meshes and incomplete face subsets provide surface clearance; subsets collide only with their named faces. Empty subsets are an error.

parameters.name: usdGen:deepPenetrationMode
parameters.description: Choose collide for collision correction alone, or cutThenCollide to temporarily shorten deeply penetrating strands before correcting contact. Shortening is recalculated from the incoming strand at each frame, so the original incoming length returns when contact clears.

parameters.name: usdGen:cutDepthThreshold
parameters.description: Signed interior depth in stage units at which temporary shortening begins in cutThenCollide mode. Use a finite nonnegative value; the practice scene uses 0.15. For its closed Catmull-Clark Shield, this is an inset from the evaluated subdivision limit. Collision correction still uses the outer evaluated boundary, independently of this threshold and its blend. This control has no effect in collide mode.

parameters.name: usdGen:cutBlendDepth
parameters.description: Distance in stage units over which shortening gradually turns on beyond cutDepthThreshold. Larger values make the transition more gradual. Use a finite positive value; the default and practice value are 0.02. This control has no effect in collide mode.

parameters.name: usdGen:offset
parameters.description: Extra clearance in stage units beyond the evaluated collider boundary, including the subdivision limit when supported. Closed meshes eject interior CVs even at offset 0; open surfaces correct only CVs closer than offset.

parameters.name: usdGen:pushAmount
parameters.description: Fraction of the collision correction applied per sweep. Use 1 for the full correction; 0 leaves curves unchanged.

parameters.name: usdGen:iterations
parameters.description: Number of correction sweeps, at least 1. More passes can help when a correction encounters another collider.

parameters.name: usdGen:resolveType
parameters.description: Flexible moves affected CVs individually and may change segment lengths. Stiff rotates downstream strands about the last clean CV, preserving segment lengths; if the root is affected, it translates the strand.

workflow: Open the linked collide practice scene in usdview and choose Camera > Select Camera > CamMotion (/World/CamMotion). The visible /World/Shield sphere starts clear at frame 0, descends to center Y 0.525 by frame 27, then slides from center Z 0.5 to 0.85 by frame 99 through the 8,000-strand clumped patch.
Select /World/Groom/Fur/Ops/collide in the Scene Graph, open Window > Noodles Editor and press A in Noodles to show its native controls.

Select /World/Shield and add it to Noodles. Its editable Mesh subdivisionScheme token is catmullClark; keep that opinion to collide against the smooth limit. In usdview choose Display > Complexity > Very High to see the subdivided sphere. Viewport complexity changes the displayed mesh detail, while native Collide evaluates the authored subdivision scheme independently.

Inspect the usdGen:colliders relationship: it names both /World/Shield and the invisible closed /World/ScalpVolume under the patch. The second target is a physical collision floor, not a rendered prop or hidden correction outside Collide.

To edit the motion visually, select /World/Shield in the Scene Graph and add it to Noodles. In the root edit layer choose Write Values > Animation (key at current frame), set Current Frame to 27, then edit the Y component of xformOp:translate. The full keyed scene also has frames 0 and 99; save and reopen it to check all three keys.

For a fur-only comparison at frame 27 or 99, open Window > Layer Editor and choose Session Layer as the edit target. Select /World/Shield in the Scene Graph, then choose Edit > Make Invisible (Ctrl+H). Wait for the hair to settle and select its visibility property to inspect the invisible value. The Shield still participates in Collide: keep both /World/Shield and /World/ScalpVolume in usdGen:colliders. Choose Edit > Remove Session Visibility (Ctrl+U) to show the sphere again, then restore your previous edit target. This inspection uses a session opinion and needs no source-layer save.

At frame 27 or 99, compare pushAmount 0 with 1 while keeping offset 0, iterations 128 and flexible resolution. Native correction moves affected fur around the Shield's Catmull-Clark limit and the authored polygon under-patch floor.

For deep contact, choose cutThenCollide with flexible resolution. Set cutDepthThreshold 0.15 and cutBlendDepth 0.02. Both distances use stage units: 0.15 defines an inset activation depth inside the evaluated subdivision limit, and 0.02 controls how gradually temporary shortening turns on beyond it. Shallow contact bends around the outer collision boundary without triggering the cut.

In Storm, press Play to inspect contact over the timeline range. Play waits for complete current-frame hair and its converged viewport presentation before advancing; slow cooks slow playback. Manual scrubbing remains progressive. Hold frames 0, 27 and 99 for exact comparisons. Temporary shortening disappears when contact clears. Flexible collision after the cut may still change segment lengths.

Press Playblast next to Play and choose an MP4 output to record the displayed timeline range at its FPS. Each movie frame waits for complete current-frame hair and viewport presentation; Cancel restores the previous viewer state.
Try a small positive offset when B-spline smoothing or strand width needs extra clearance, then restore the authored 0 and save the edit-target layer.
tips: Use a consistently oriented watertight mesh for solid collision. Author catmullClark, loop or bilinear subdivisionScheme to use its evaluated limit surface; use none for polygon collision. Open surfaces and incomplete face subsets provide clearance instead.
List every physical target in usdGen:colliders, including an invisible closed floor if the patch needs one. The bound scalp also participates in collision.

The dense 8,000-strand practice scene can cook slowly. Storm Play holds each frame until its hair and viewport presentation are complete. Use Playblast for a movie at the timeline FPS even when interactive playback runs more slowly; manual scrubbing still shows progressively arriving tiles.
The cut applies to the whole strand. With a partial mask, a weighted point can select shortening that also moves zero-masked CVs; an all-zero strand remains unchanged.
pitfalls: Default pushAmount=0 produces no correction. For an open surface, offset=0 also produces no correction.
Open or inconsistently oriented meshes do not define a reliable solid interior. A face subset is a solid only if its selected faces form a watertight mesh.

An otherwise-valid unsupported or rejected topology warns with the collider path, scheme and reason before polygon fallback. Unsafe geometry, failed limit evaluation or an unmet precision cap can produce a hard diagnostic instead.

Flexible correction after temporary shortening can change segment lengths. Final control-polygon chord lengths do not identify the prepared retained prefix. Compare incoming and prepared geometry separately when measuring the cut; the full incoming length is available again when deep contact clears.

Inspect the full strand near concave or multiple colliders. Collide corrects curve CVs and control-polygon segments. Rendered B-splines and strand width can extend beyond that control polygon; a small positive offset can provide extra clearance.
A GeomSubset with no faces is an error.

operators.title: Wind
operators.summary: Bend strands with steady wind, gusts, and broad or fine traveling billows, resisted by stiffness.
operators.execution: CPU reference; CUDA admission rejects this type

parameters.name: usdGen:enabled
parameters.description: Enable or mute this node. A muted modifier passes its input through; a muted source produces no curves.

parameters.name: usdGen:seed
parameters.description: Repeatable random seed for draws made by this operator.

parameters.name: usdGen:mask
parameters.description: Effect weight from 0 to 1. Connect a UsdGenExpression for variation per curve or per CV.

parameters.name: usdGen:direction
parameters.description: Direction of displacement. Use (1, 0, 0) for +X. The vector is normalized, so change strength to increase the bend.

parameters.name: usdGen:constStrength
parameters.description: Steady displacement in stage units before stiffness and the root-to-tip weight. Zero gives a calm baseline when gustStrength and both billow strengths are also zero.

parameters.name: usdGen:gustStrength
parameters.description: Amount of time-varying noise added to steady strength. Without effective clump cohesion it varies per strand; cohesive CVs share the gust field at their clump rest anchor to the extent of their surviving weights. Set 0 while comparing steady bends.

parameters.name: usdGen:stiffness
parameters.description: Resistance from 0 (fully flexible) to 1 (fully resistant with a flat unit ramp). The ramp multiplies this value. Roots stay fixed because Wind also weights displacement from zero at the root to full at the tip.

parameters.name: usdGen:stiffness:knots
parameters.description: Root-to-tip multiplier for stiffness: each pair is (strand position, multiplier). A high root multiplier and low tip multiplier leave the upper strand more flexible.

parameters.name: usdGen:stiffness:interpolation
parameters.description: Interpolation of the stiffness ramp.

parameters.name: usdGen:billowLowStrength
parameters.description: Amplitude of the broad traveling wave in stage units. Zero disables this band. It follows a root-anchored squared root-to-tip envelope, then mask and stiffness.

parameters.name: usdGen:billowLowFrequency
parameters.description: Broad-wave spatial frequency in cycles per stage unit along normalized wind direction. Individual motion samples strand rest positions; effective clump cohesion blends in waves at clump rest anchors. Smaller values make wider billows. Use a finite nonnegative value.

parameters.name: usdGen:billowLowRate
parameters.description: Broad-wave travel rate in cycles per second. Smaller values make the billow move more slowly. A negative rate reverses travel.

parameters.name: usdGen:billowHighStrength
parameters.description: Amplitude of the finer traveling wave in stage units. Zero disables this band. Its cubed root-to-tip envelope concentrates movement toward tips, then mask and stiffness apply.

parameters.name: usdGen:billowHighFrequency
parameters.description: Fine-wave spatial frequency in cycles per stage unit along wind direction, sampled at strand rest positions and effective clump rest anchors. Larger values make closer ripples. Use a finite nonnegative value.

parameters.name: usdGen:billowHighRate
parameters.description: Fine-wave travel rate in cycles per second. Larger values make ripples move faster. A negative rate reverses travel.

workflow: Open the linked 6,500-strand wind-clumped.usda practice scene in usdview with Storm. Choose Camera > Select Camera > Cam (/World/Cam) for the elevated view, then press Play over frames 0–99 at 24 fps to inspect broad billows and finer faster ripples. Play waits for complete current-frame hair and converged viewport presentation before advancing; slow cooks slow playback, while manual scrubbing remains progressive.

Press Playblast next to Play and choose an MP4 output to record the displayed timeline range at its FPS. The movie captures each ready viewport frame even when cooking is slower than playback; Cancel restores the previous viewer state.
Select /World/Groom/Fur/Ops/wind in the Scene Graph, open Window > Noodles Editor and press A in Noodles to show its native controls.

Start with direction (1, 0, 0), constStrength 0.08, gustStrength 0 and stiffness 0.12. The example uses low strength 0.10, frequency 0.75 and rate 0.24, plus high strength 0.045, frequency 3 and rate 0.96.
Set billowHighStrength to 0 to isolate the slow broad wave; restore 0.045 to add fine ripples. Try billowLowFrequency 0.375 for twice the wavelength, then restore 0.75.

Set billowHighRate to 0.48 for slower ripples, then restore 0.96. Compare wind-unclumped.usda at the same frames: both scenes retain the same 6,500 Scatter roots and Wind settings, while Clump enabled changes from on to off. Save the edit-target layer after comparing playback.
tips: Judge movement during usdview playback. A still frame cannot show the difference between wave frequencies and travel rates.
Isolate each band by setting the other band’s strength to 0. The low wave has a squared root-to-tip envelope; the high wave concentrates motion toward tips. Roots remain fixed.

Place Clump upstream of Wind for coherent tuft motion. Gusts and broad billows consume surviving cohesion from coarse to fine; fine billows consume it from fine to coarse. A fully cohesive fine level can leave no coarse share at that CV. Clump amount, profile, mask and strays set the effective weights; any remainder stays individual. Constant wind keeps its authored per-strand strength.
pitfalls: Zero constant, gust and billow strengths leave curves unchanged.
Billow frequency must be finite and nonnegative; strengths and rates must be finite. Negative rates reverse travel.

Billows are coherent waves over rest position and cook time. Gusts start from deterministic per-strand noise, then share clump-anchored motion where effective cohesion survives. A clump ID without weight does not imply shared motion; playback is needed to judge the result.
